# False presupposition (LOG004)

The instruction presupposes a fact not established; invites confabulation.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `log-false-presupposition` |
| Family | logical |
| Applies to | `prompt` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | LLM |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

The instruction takes an unestablished fact as given, so the model confabulates a reason rather than checking.

Bad:  Explain why the cache lookup fails.
Good: Check whether the cache lookup fails; if it does, explain why.

Not a finding when the presupposed fact is established earlier.

## Detector metadata

```yaml
- kind: llm
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
```
